description: Fail-closed autonomy authority for each email action class. Stage 1 = approval required. Stage 2 = autonomous send allowed (with auto-CC + undo window). Promotion requires Brian's PR approval. Demotion is automatic on any incident.

1.label: Approval required
1.description: Every send requires Brian's checkbox in Google Tasks before it goes out.

2.label: Autonomous send
2.description: Kerri may send without per-email approval. Auto-CC brian@ on every send. 4-hour undo window. Any incident auto-demotes to stage 1.

safetyInvariants.autoCcBrian: always, even at stage 2 - this is a safety net, never disabled
safetyInvariants.demotionPolicy: automatic on any incident - only removing authority is self-applicable; Kerri may demote herself but NEVER promote herself
safetyInvariants.promotionPolicy: requires a PR modifying this file + a brain/wiki/decisions/ page with the evidence + Brian's merge
